scenes.title: Buying one? Check these 5 things first.
Pull the fill plug.
scenes.body: Runny grease means diff oil is getting in: the inner axle seals have gone.

scenes.title: Look for coolant at the head.
scenes.body: Weeping at the head-to-block joint. It's on every 80 buyer's list.

scenes.title: Footwells and rear windows.
scenes.body: Get underneath. Trucks from salted-road states are the worst.

scenes.title: Cracks around the steering box.
scenes.body: Worse on trucks that have run 33s or bigger.

scenes.title: Every window. Every locker.
scenes.body: Regulators were the biggest problem on mine, and a vacuum leak stopped the lockers engaging.
